name: Goodluck Nathan
bio:
I am Goodluck Nathan, born and educated in Arusha. As one of the youngest guides from the Meru tribe living along the slopes of Mount Meru in the Arusha region, I developed a love for the outdoors and a deep appreciation for the environment at an early age. Growing up with my uncle, who was a tour guide and conservationist, further inspired me.
In 2015, I began my journey to become a tour guide, focusing on bird identification, habits, and habitats for four years. In 2019, I enrolled in a tour guiding college and earned a diploma in tourism and hospitality in 2021. I initially worked as a transfer guide, leading activities around the Arusha and Kilimanjaro regions.
To enhance my skills, I trained for a year as a game package guide in the Mara River area. After completing my training, I joined Mazingira Safari as a full-time safari guide. I thoroughly enjoy nature, particularly birding.
